text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—After the URA Finals championship race. 
Trainer Kiryuin calls <username> a trainer
she looks 
up to, praising them from the bottom of 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sting of defeat lingers in their 
hearts. However, it serves as fuel for 
growth. Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek 
looked straight ahead toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for a tomorrow stronger than
today, 
the two set off once more, striving 
together to build up their efforts step
by step.
